findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping to document lookups
findings.body: When tenants share a database, querying only by `documentId` no longer enforces `ctx.tenantId`. A caller possessing another tenant’s document ID can retrieve that tenant’s record; the previous implementation filtered on both keys.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the three-argument `loadDocument` contract
findings.body: Existing TypeScript consumers of `loadDocument(db, tenantId, documentId)` will fail type checking. JavaScript consumers will instead use `tenantId` as the document ID and silently ignore the actual document ID.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported cache module
findings.body: Deleting `src/cache.ts` removes `readCached` without a replacement or forwarding module. Downstream imports of this exported module will now fail module resolution, contrary to the stated goal of preserving existing contracts.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping when loading documents
findings.body:
With a shared database containing identical document IDs for multiple tenants, `getDocument` now queries only by `documentId`, allowing cross-tenant data retrieval or ambiguous results.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the three-argument `loadDocument` API
findings.body:
Existing TypeScript callers using `loadDocument(db, tenantId, documentId)` now fail type checking; JavaScript callers silently use `tenantId` as the document ID and ignore the actual document ID.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Restore the exported cache module
findings.body:
Any consumer or test importing `src/cache` or `readCached` now fails module resolution because the exported module was deleted without a replacement.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant scoping to document lookups
findings.body:
Removing `tenantId` from the database filter breaks tenant isolation. In a shared multi-tenant database, a caller can retrieve another tenant’s document by supplying its `documentId`, because `ctx.tenantId` is no longer enforced.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
